note: 与其他 Emissary 共享台词模板,详见 Emissary_Braum.json 的说明和 GLOSSARY.md。

messages.context: 无进行中委托时的开场白,自称国王真正最爱吃甜瓜
messages.text: I know what all the others say, but I am the King's true favorite emissary.
messages.zh: 我知道别人都是怎么说的,但我才是国王真正最喜欢的委托官。
messages.raw: §fI know what all the others say, but I am the King's true favorite emissary.

messages.context: 开场白第二句,点名要甜瓜
messages.text: As the King's true favorite only I know he secretly loves melon.
messages.zh: 作为国王真正的心头好,只有我知道他其实偷偷爱吃甜瓜。
messages.raw: §fAs the King's true favorite only I know he secretly loves melon.

messages.context: 拒绝/取消委托时的台词
messages.text: The King will surely punish you for this disrespect!
messages.zh: 国王一定会因为你这份无礼惩罚你的!
messages.raw: §fThe King will surely punish you for this disrespect!

todo: 未采集到明确的 'Completing'(完成委托)台词,只有开场白两句和拒绝台词,需要后续核实是否遗漏。
